name: Hell
description: A bounded prison with literal gates, not an omnipresent constraint -- the mechanism by which Satan can physically leave lives here: Hell is walled by fire and guarded at its one gate by Sin and Death, who hold the key. This is the answer to 'why can Satan leave Hell' (docs/planning/TFAH-brief.md §9): it is a place with a door, not a metaphysical state with no exit.
power_structure: Self-styled principality under Satan; infernal council of Beelzebub, Moloch, Belial, Mammon

notable_locations.name: Pandemonium
notable_locations.description: Capital of Hell, built by Mulciber's design from ore Mammon's crews mine -- name is Milton's own coinage, literally 'all demons.'

notable_locations.name: The Gates of Hell
notable_locations.description: The physical exit, guarded by Sin and Death.

notable_locations.name: The Burning Lake
notable_locations.description: Where the fallen angels first land after their nine-day fall from Heaven.

story_hooks: Satan's departure through the gate (Book II)
